info.bio:
There are multiple artists/bands/groups with this name:

1) British industrial/free jazz from early '90s
2) 1st generation k-pop boy group. Also named G.O.D.
3) Romanian metal band from '90s to present
4) Aussie punk rock band from mid to late '80s
5) Netherlands punk/metal band from late '80s and early '90s 
6) American noise/imrov two-piece
7) American one man noise/drone project
8) Chicago drill rapper from Englewood. 
9) One-man instrumental djent project

scenes.name: Sonidos progresivos de los noventa
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Phish devuelven el rock alternativo a la radio y legitiman el regreso a la estética progresiva, sobre todo en la Costa Este: Blues Traveler, Motherhead Bug y Sulfur, Spin Doctors, Klezmatics, Cul De Sac (Ecim, China Gate) y Run On. El noise-punk-jazz de God Is My Co-pilot, Molecules, Love Child, Blowhole, Harry Pussy. Virginia como epicentro (Echolyn, Boud Deun, Rake, Dave Matthews Band). Solistas: Marc Ribot, Nicky Skopelitis, Buckethead, Loren Mazzacane, los zappianos Ant-Bee y Mike Keneally, Gary Lucas, Alan Licht, Bob Drake. En la Costa Oeste, Primus (Frizzle Fry), Mr Bungle, Amy Denio, Caveman Shoestore, Thessalonians. Internacional: Philharmonie, Xaal, Volapuk, Kevin Martin (God, Techno Animal, Ice, Bug). Y la Babel final: Bright, Meringue, Cerberus Shoal, Tin Hat Trio, Species Being.

podcast.title: Toured with Scream
podcast.body: This Dutch band toured with Scream, leading to a connection between their member Toss Newyn Huizen and Dave Grohl. Newyn Huizen later assisted Dave Grohl with his solo demos under the alias Harling Talks AD. "a guy named Toss Newyn Huizen from a Dutch band called God, who had toured with Scream, Dave created a new alias."
